fixture: Fair arrival gives 198 coins. Passive ticks are paused. Set the player location and gate prerequisites; skip intervening prayer windows with the game clock to Thursday day 8. The real road then advances 90 minutes. A real River Market prayer precedes the Jisra congregation, so jm04 records two on-time prayers and congregations. The solo and bridge paths start fresh.
